lead: The default values, the answers to open questions and the parameters you can change. Classification thresholds (Tables 7 to 11) are fixed.

sections.answers: Answers to open questions in use

playground.title: Play with parameters
playground.body: Override the capacities and COPs of Tables 4 and 5 and the economic parameters of Table 6. Results then carry the “Custom parameters” badge. Your values are saved in the project.

confirm.title: Reset all parameters?
confirm.body: Every custom value is removed and the default values of Tables 4 to 6 are used again.

flags.OQ-18: Table 6 gives no value; the Quick Check uses 0 (OQ-18).
flags.OQ-26: Capacities are used as absolute values per selected source for the whole project (OQ-26).

answers.lead: The methodology leaves some points open. These answers are applied in every calculation.

OQ-01.title: Percent values used directly in equations
OQ-01.answer: Divide all % values (shares, interest rate, PV reduction) by 100 before use. N_i,p stays fractional (no rounding); the UI rounds for display only.

OQ-02.title: No default values for industry
OQ-02.answer: Industry is selectable in the share grid. Any industry share > 0 forces 'Further analysis required' (QCT-RULE-INDUSTRY). Industry adds no demand, floor area or base/energy-price revenue (no defaults). Terms based on N_total (EQ-3.3, 3.9c, 3.10d) use the entered total, industry included. The UI shows a note.

OQ-03.title: Construction periods overlap at 1919
OQ-03.answer: Show the period labels verbatim. No calculation depends on the boundary year.

OQ-04.title: Role of the "rural, sub-urban, urban" input
OQ-04.answer: Not a user input. The category is derived from the TBL-8 class of the computed ρ_building (Low → rural, Medium → sub-urban, High → urban) and shown read-only.

OQ-05.title: Form of the optional manual demand input
OQ-05.answer: Two optional totals in kWh/a (heating, cooling). When set, they replace the EQ-3.2c / EQ-3.2d results. Base-price revenue terms still use N_i,p · A.

OQ-06.title: PV: input and application of the 30 % reduction
OQ-06.answer: PV is a yes/no input. If yes, C_el is multiplied by (1 − 0.30).

OQ-07.title: Q_cool,total glossed as heating demand in §3.2
OQ-07.answer: Q_cool,total is the total annual cooling demand (the §3.2 gloss is a slip).

OQ-08.title: Overloaded symbols and inconsistent indices
OQ-08.answer: Read indices by context: i = building type (§3.1, 3.2, 3.9) or source (§3.8, 3.10a-c, 3.11); in EQ-3.10e i = interest rate and p = depreciation period. A = average floor area of type i, period p (TBL-3). EQ-3.2a/b are evaluated per cell (i, p). C_i,total = sum of C_i over the selected sources.

OQ-10.title: Heat density unit vs thresholds
OQ-10.answer: ρ_heat is computed in kWh/m and compared with the TBL-9 thresholds in MWh/m (ρ_heat / 1000). The UI shows MWh/m.

OQ-11.title: Per-source supply vs total supply in coverage
OQ-11.answer: Several sources may be selected. Coverage uses the sum of the per-source supplies. C_i and C_el are computed per source and summed.

OQ-12.title: No formula for the cooling-to-heating ratio
OQ-12.answer: CH = min(Q_cool,total, Q_heat,total) / max(Q_cool,total, Q_heat,total), always 0-1. The UI names the dominant demand. Both demands 0 → not applicable.

OQ-13.title: Sources without COP or capacity
OQ-13.answer: Solar thermal (no COP): Q_heat,supply = Q_heat,available, no heat-pump electricity. Sources without cooling capacity (waste heat, solar thermal): Q_cool,supply = 0.

OQ-14.title: COP definition and COP_H / COP_C
OQ-14.answer: COP means coefficient of performance. COP_H = TBL-4 COP and COP_C = TBL-5 COP of the same source.

OQ-15.title: p_C,energy vs p_HC,energy
OQ-15.answer: p_C,energy is the cooling energy price (TBL-6, cooling_energy_price).

OQ-16.title: Base prices per m² without time unit
OQ-16.answer: Base prices are € per m² floor area per year.

OQ-17.title: C_overall adds both C_i and C_i,total
OQ-17.answer: C_overall = C_HP · N_total + C_net + C_i,total (C_i is not added a second time).

OQ-18.title: Ambient air installation cost "-" with unit €/kWh
OQ-18.answer: Ambient air installation cost = 0 €/(kWh/a); heat pumps are already in C_HP · N_total. Shown as an assumption in the UI.

OQ-20.title: Range boundaries in the classification tables
OQ-20.answer: Lower bound inclusive, no gaps. Coverage: ≥100 / ≥90 / ≥70 / <70 %. Building density: >30 / ≥10 / <10 buildings/ha. Heat density: >1.5 / ≥0.5 / <0.5 MWh/m. CH ratio: ≥0.8 / ≥0.3 / <0.3.

OQ-21.title: "Economic assessment favorable / clearly unfavorable" is not defined
OQ-21.answer: E = R_overall / (C_annual + C_el + C_O&M). E ≥ 1.0 favorable; E < 0.7 clearly unfavorable; otherwise unclear (→ Further analysis required). Constants live in one config file.

OQ-22.title: Combinations not covered by the overall rule
OQ-22.answer: Precedence: (1) industry share > 0 or any selected source with Unknown potential → Further analysis required; (2) Not promising; (3) Promising; (4) otherwise Further analysis required. A demand is relevant when > 0. Missing required inputs → no result (incomplete).

OQ-26.title: Source capacities are small compared with default demand
OQ-26.answer: Use TBL-4/5 capacities verbatim as absolute values per selected source for the whole project. Flag this in the Assumptions panel and ask the organisers. "Play with parameters" may override capacities (results then marked as custom). Check: "Promising" is still reachable for about 2-15 buildings with several medium/high sources.
